visible_state: Withdrawal arrived according to hand tracking; this is not insertion evidence.
Current right view shows the gold contact edge exposed above the PCIe socket. Its projected slope differs from the socket's long rim.
Wrist views show similar card-to-finger appearance before and after withdrawal, but aperture and images do not prove a secure grasp.
The bulky cooler, nearby motherboard surfaces, case rim and partly hidden bracket region must all be considered. The arm occludes much of the left view.

failure_hypotheses.hypothesis: Card attitude or lateral alignment prevented full-length connector engagement.
failure_hypotheses.support: Historical nonarrival and tilt; current connector and socket have different image slopes.
failure_hypotheses.falsifier: Aligned depth and additional views show compatible connector/socket directions, insertion axis and full-length registration; apparent slope difference is perspective.

failure_hypotheses.hypothesis: Bracket, cooler or gripper contacted surrounding structure before the connector could seat.
failure_hypotheses.support: Large surrounding envelope and occluded bracket region make secondary interference plausible; contact is not directly visible.
failure_hypotheses.falsifier: Inspection establishes separated swept envelopes throughout the previously attempted approach, with card attitude stable relative to the hand.

next_stage: Hold the withdrawn configuration and inspect alignment, grasp stability and the whole insertion envelope before selecting any correction. Do not descend again yet.

anchors.surface: left portion of exposed gold contact strip
right portion of exposed gold contact strip
left portion of socket metal rim
right portion of socket metal rim

remaining_stages: Inspect: sample aligned depth on these solid surfaces; obtain views of bracket, socket ends and finger/cooler surroundings.
Reorient and reposition only after establishing a clear swept envelope; verify connector registration and unchanged card-to-hand relationship.
Attempt a short visually monitored seating approach only after alignment is verified; confirm both ends seated before release.
stop_conditions: Card slips, tilts unexpectedly or separates from the fingers.
Hand advances without corresponding card progress, or visible interference develops.
Alignment, bracket access or seating remains unobservable.
missing_evidence: Depth samples, bracket/latch visibility, verified grasp and full-envelope clearance.
uncertainty: Pixels are sampling candidates, not measured geometry. Thin-edge depth may mix surfaces; FK locates the hand, not the card.
